sheets.noticed: A green bar chart, 'Surface temperature by land cover', five bars 52 down to 29. Looks like a lecture slide.
Same slide, nothing moving. Small text I'm not going to read. Only the captions change.
Still the same slide for almost six seconds, I'm about to tune out; at the very end the slide shrinks and a new bar slides in.
Slide moves to the left and a separate big 'asphalt 52 °C' bar appears on the right, then a 'tree canopy' bar grows. Two charts at once, a bit busy.
Asphalt vs tree canopy, the canopy bar is shorter but has no number yet.
'29 °C' pops on the canopy bar. Okay, big difference.
An orange bracket shows the gap, '23 °C', but it's jammed right on top of the '29 °C' label so it's hard to read.
'a few steps apart'. That's the point, I get it. Picture stops changing.
Silence and the same frozen picture, then 'Grass and bare soil sit in between' in caps. I already got the point, so I looked away.

remembers: On a hot July day asphalt got to 52 degrees while the ground under trees was only 29, a 23 degree difference just a few steps apart.
